authority_blockers.reason: P6 high-level scope is frozen by Canonical and the M9 runway, but exact model/training snapshot identity, leakage/holdout policy, applicability/uncertainty semantics, counterfactual identifiability, recommendation/release rules, Joint/LVC interoperability, role/privacy projection, exact DTO/API/GUI contracts and C4 admission evidence require machine-authority closure before dependent P6 implementation may claim completion.

batches.name: P6 authority + leakage-safe input + interoperability substrate

tasks.deliverable: P6 model/projection/counterfactual/interoperability/recommendation authority and C4 admission guard
tasks.minimum_acceptance: Versioned machine authority freezes exact P6 source/model/profile/training-snapshot identity, forecast/counterfactual/recommendation separation, leakage/holdout rules, applicability/domain/uncertainty semantics, intervention and identifiability rules, Joint/LVC interoperability boundaries, role/privacy/release/audit rules, exact cross-layer DTOs and C4 admission evidence. No implementation-local formula, threshold, causal upgrade, model alias or hidden source substitution is permitted.

tasks.deliverable: Exact forecast/counterfactual request substrate and leakage-safe dataset snapshots
tasks.minimum_acceptance: Materialize immutable request/input snapshots binding exact factual source revisions, subject/composition/mission scope, target/horizon, as-of cutoff, model/profile references and training/validation snapshot identity; future/same-outcome leakage, current/latest/default source resolution and hidden P1-P5 recomputation fail closed.

tasks.deliverable: Exact Joint/LVC and external interoperability snapshot contract
tasks.minimum_acceptance: Freeze deterministic inbound/outbound identity, schema/profile/version, units, time/as-of, source/projection class, provenance, uncertainty/applicability and release state for authorized Joint/LVC/external exchange; missing authority, lossy phase conversion, source/projection conflation and unversioned external aliases fail closed.

tasks.deliverable: Deterministic model-revision training and validation artifact
tasks.minimum_acceptance: Produce immutable model revision identity bound to exact code/profile, training snapshot, feature contract, target contract, validation/holdout evidence, random/deterministic controls and provenance. Training or validation may execute only model families explicitly adopted by C3; no model is resolved by latest/current/default.

Publish exact applicability/domain and uncertainty/calibration evidence for each model revision, including explicit unavailable/out-of-domain/not-identifiable states. A mathematically executable model remains product-invalid when applicability or required calibration fails; no OOD/unavailable state is encoded as zero.

Publish deterministic forecast revision bound to exact factual sources, request, model revision, assumptions, horizon, applicability, uncertainty and as-of cutoff. Projection is physically and semantically separate from P1-P5 facts/assessments and never upgrades into observed truth.

tasks.deliverable: Model/projection longitudinal replay, supersession and validation lineage
tasks.minimum_acceptance: Historical model and forecast revisions remain exact-ID addressable with exact as-of replay; model/profile/source changes create new revision/series boundaries; later observed outcomes may validate prior projections but never rewrite the historical prediction or its original knowledge-time context.

Golden vectors prove deterministic model/projection identity, exact source lineage, leakage-safe snapshots, applicability/calibration and replay. Negatives reject future/same-outcome leakage, stale or aliased source/model revisions, OOD-zero coercion, missing required uncertainty, lossy interoperability and premature P6 claims.

tasks.deliverable: Counterfactual request/intervention projection with explicit assumption trace
tasks.minimum_acceptance: Counterfactual revisions bind exact factual baseline, explicit typed intervention, held-fixed assumptions, model revision, applicability/identifiability status, uncertainty and provenance. Association-only evidence cannot silently become causal authority; unsupported causal claims fail closed.

tasks.deliverable: Governed recommendation/advisory revision and approval boundary
tasks.minimum_acceptance: Recommendation/advisory revisions reference exact forecast/counterfactual products, objective/constraint set, allowed action space, applicability and uncertainty; they remain advisory governed products, never facts or commands, and require exact immutable review/approval/release provenance.

Expose exact revision-bound reads/writes only with idempotent authorized mutation/release semantics; current/latest/default aliases, recompute-on-read, hidden source substitution, claim upgrade and projection-as-fact transport are forbidden.

GUI visibly separates P1-P5 observed/adjusted/capability/assessment products from P6 forecast, counterfactual and recommendation; exact source/model/revision, assumptions, applicability, uncertainty and approval state remain visible; presentation performs no business recomputation or persistence.

Runtime/API/GUI/interoperability enforce frozen role/privacy and model/release permissions, pseudonymous projection and privileged audit/export evidence; unauthorized identity, model, training evidence, projection, release or export access fails closed and sensitive payloads are excluded from unrestricted logs.

tasks.deliverable: P6 counterfactual/recommendation/API/GUI/security cross-platform and P1-P5 non-regression qualification
tasks.minimum_acceptance: One exact candidate proves Windows/Linux canonical serialization/logical identity equivalence, exact replay, fact-vs-projection transport/presentation, role/privacy/release behavior, Joint/LVC interoperability guards, immutable P1-P5 hashes/provenance, DB 1.6.0 compatibility and retained M5-M8 guarantees.

tasks.deliverable: M9 Exit review and C4 P6 admission decision
tasks.minimum_acceptance: Exact 15/15 M9 evidence, C3 authority closure, leakage-safe input/interoperability/model/applicability/forecast/counterfactual/recommendation/replay/API/GUI/security/cross-platform gates and P1-P5 non-regression all pass with failed_acceptance=[]; only protected-main exact M9 Exit GO admits P6.
